text:
maya: Quick nudge — we have the release cutoff tomorrow 17:00 PT. Please add a release-notes entry for any user-visible change (bugfix, API tweak, perf) before then. Use the small template below.

sam: Thanks — is the version bump manual or CI does it?

maya: Manual for now. Steps: 1) add note under `docs/release_notes/unreleased.md` 2) open PR with label `release-ready` 3) assign to release manager (I'll take this cycle) 4) after merge run `./scripts/bump-version.sh <new-version>` and tag.

alex: Template?

maya: Use this short entry format:```- Component: runtime
  Summary: Reduced cold-start latency for sequence caching
  Impact: lower tail latency for short requests
  PR: #1234``` Keep entries 1-2 lines summary + one line impact. No long prose.

jordan: For branch coordination — if you need a hotfix on main after cutoff, label `rc/hotfix` and ping me. We'll cherry-pick to the release branch.

sam: CI gating? I have a flaky test that sometimes fails lint but not unit tests.

devops-bot: Reminder: the release pipeline requires all checks to pass in `release` context. Run `./ci/fast-check.sh` to pre-validate.

maya: If lint is the only blocker, add `ci/allow-lint-fix` as a draft fix in the same PR and note it in the release notes entry. But we prefer green CI.

alex: Also tagging: after bumping and tagging, please add the tag to the PR description and set the release milestone.

sam: Got it. I'll push my changelog note now and add `release-ready`.

maya: Awesome, thanks. Quick checklist to copy:```- Add entry to docs/release_notes/unreleased.md
- Mark PR with `release-ready` label
- Assign to release manager
- Run `./scripts/bump-version.sh` after merge
- Create tag and update milestone
- Confirm CI checks in `release` context are green```

jordan: I'll monitor merges and run the release cut at 17:15 PT in case of slight delay. :calendar:

sam: pinged @maya with PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/999 :thumbsup:

maya: Received, will review in the morning. If anyone wants a quick sanity check on wording, add me as reviewer.

devops-bot: Scheduled reminder will post 2 hours before cutoff.
